Definition: from G4314 and G4198; to journey towards, i.e. approach (not the same as G4313):--go before.
BiblicalUsage: Prosporeuomai means to journey toward, to come up to someone. It appears once, when James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came unto Jesus, saying, Master, we would that Thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe their bold asking is a warning to me: they came to Jesus to get a throne, and He taught them that greatness is a cup and a baptism.
RelatedPeople: James, Son of Zebedee; John the Apostle; Jesus
